init.title: Timelapse Profiles
init.description: Manage your timelapse profiles. Each profile watches an entity and automatically creates timelapses.

data.action: What would you like to do?

profile_enabled_conflict.title: Confirm Automatic timelapse
profile_enabled_conflict.description: Automatic timelapse changed while this dialog was open. Your other edits have not been saved. The checkbox shows the current live setting. Choose its final value to save your edits, or cancel to leave the profile unchanged.

profile_delete.title: Delete profile
profile_delete.description: Deleting disarms this profile and stops its active recording. A video will be built from its frames and the recording's saved cleanup policy will apply, including its failed-build retention setting. Existing videos are preserved. If the server cannot stop capture, deletion is blocked and the profile stays disabled.

connection.title: Update server connection
connection.description: Update the URL or API key. Finish tracked recordings before changing the server URL.

profile_basic.title: Profile Setup
profile_basic.description: Configure the stream source and trigger entity for this profile.

data_description.enabled: Arm this profile for future trigger transitions. Turning it off stops an active recording and builds its video. Turning it on does not start an already-active process; use Start now for that.
data_description.name: A friendly name for this timelapse profile
data_description.stream_url: The RTSP, HTTP, or device URL for the camera
data_description.stream_type: The protocol type of the camera stream
data_description.trigger_entity: The entity to watch for state changes
data_description.active_state: Use the raw state from Developer Tools > States (not a translated display label). Capture starts on entry and stops on exit.
data_description.exclude_states: Comma-separated states that should NOT trigger a stop. If the entity enters one of these states, capturing continues.
data_description.start_delay_seconds: Seconds to wait before creating the job after the entity enters the active state. If the entity leaves the active state during this delay, the job is not created. Set to 0 for no delay.
data_description.debounce_seconds: Seconds to wait before stopping after the entity leaves the active state (prevents false triggers)

profile_capture.title: Capture & Video Settings
profile_capture.description:
Configure how frames are captured and how the timelapse video is built.

{tag_warning}

data.auto_cleanup: Auto-delete job after video is built
data.preserve_failed_frames: Preserve frames if video building fails

data_description.interval_mode: Fixed: capture at a set interval. Target duration: calculate interval to produce a specific video length.
data_description.interval_seconds: Seconds between captures (minimum 10). Only used in fixed mode.
data_description.fps: Frames per second for the output timelapse video
data_description.quality: Encoding quality for the output video
data_description.capture_quality: Image quality for each captured frame
data_description.auto_cleanup: Delete the job and raw frames after a successful video build. The failed-build retention setting controls cleanup after a confirmed failure. When off, frames are always kept.
data_description.preserve_failed_frames: On by default. Keep frames for recovery after a confirmed failed build. Turn off to delete them when auto-cleanup is enabled; the failed recording cannot then be rebuilt. Connection errors and unknown build states never trigger deletion.
data_description.tag_ids: ChronoSnap tags to apply to the job and video

profile_target.title: Target Duration Settings
profile_target.description: The capture interval will be calculated so the final video is approximately the target duration. Formula: entity_value ÷ (target_duration × fps), minimum 10 seconds.

data_description.target_duration: Desired length of the final timelapse video in seconds
data_description.duration_entity: A numeric duration in seconds, minutes, or hours (using the entity's unit), or an ISO finish time. Numbers without a unit mean seconds; timezone-free finish times use Home Assistant's time zone.

error.invalid_name: Use a name of at most 80 characters containing more than filename punctuation.
error.invalid_stream_url: Enter a valid RTSP/HTTP URL, or /dev/videoN for a local device, matching the selected stream type.
error.active_excluded: The active state cannot also be an excluded state.
error.invalid_resolution: Enter positive dimensions as WIDTHxHEIGHT, for example 1920x1080.
error.invalid_server_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS base URL without embedded credentials, query parameters, or a fragment.
error.recordings_pending: Disarm pending starts and finish or recover all tracked recordings before changing the server URL.
error.reload_failed: Connection details were saved, but the integration could not reload. Check Home Assistant logs and retry.
error.integration_not_loaded: Load the integration before deleting a profile so its server job can be stopped safely.
error.cannot_stop: The server job could not be stopped. The profile remains disabled. Check ChronoSnap and retry deletion.
